tagline: You can now manage Lakebase snapshots programmatically.
what_it_does: You can now manage Lakebase snapshots programmatically. The snapshots API lets you create, get, list, and delete point in time snapshots of a project branch, and restore a snapshot by creating a new branch from it. A snapshot is a point in time capture of a project's root branch, including the schema and all data.
why_it_matters: Lakebase creates snapshots instantly with minimal performance impact.
